name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2063: His ask, verbatim: the shadow reader needs to know when diablo ii window is open so it doesnt just record for free. v899 built exactly this check and spent it on the wrong half - its own comment reads NO D2R WINDOW: film may keep running, but AI reads stay OFF. So the expensive lane was protected and the DISK lane was not: with the game shut, frames landed at the full rate and the only thing that ever stopped them was MIN_FREE_GB, which is running out. The archiver now consults the debounced game gate, keeps a short tail because the window vanishing IS the event worth filming, and then stops. Fails OPEN when the gate has never been measured. Four sabotages, and TWO of them passed against my first tests - both rewritten until they bit.
